svg.title: Capacity factor C_SB before and after doubling the tray spacing
svg.text: Capacity factor C_SB before and after doubling the tray spacing
Fair flooding correlation, redrawn from the curve fit given on the paper (T_s in ft)
Old column: F_lv = 0.090; new column: F_lv = 0.0999 (11% more liquid).
Go up to the curve of the tray spacing: 12 in (old), 24 in (new).
Go across to the C_sb axis.
Read C_SB ≈ 0.19 ft/s (12 in) and ≈ 0.33 ft/s (24 in): u_flood rises by about 75%.
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
